frozen_config.features: Morgan ECFP4 (radius 2, 2048 bits) + RDKit 2D descriptors (frozen list)
frozen_config.imputation: per-descriptor median fitted on the Train split only; constant columns dropped by Train-only variance
frozen_config.scaling: none (tree model; descriptors are not standardised)

valid.missing_policy: observed cells only; NaN never treated as negative

preprocessing.constant_column_rule: drop columns whose Train-split std == 0 (bit columns included)
preprocessing.descriptor_error_policy: descriptor raising or returning a non-finite value -> NaN for that cell
preprocessing.imputation: per-column median fitted on the Train split only
preprocessing.tox21_preprocessing_fit: the dataset-level Tox21 Train split (not the per-endpoint subset)

units: 12 binary toxicity endpoints; NaN = not assayed (never 0)
